claim: A NextGen collection group in Amazon OpenSearch Serverless can have a maximum of 10,000 collections, and the quota is adjustable through the Service Quotas console.
question: OpenSearch Serverless: how many collections can a NextGen collection group hold?

qualifiers.condition: Announced on 2026-08-10 (after the 2026-07-15 cutoff): not examinable yet. The previous limit was 1,500.
